notes.title: Fruitimo! Video and Streaming Guidelines
notes.content: [p]PLANETA Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, “the Company”) holds the rights to the game title [i]Fruitimo![/i]. When creating or publishing video and streaming content using [i]Fruitimo![/i], please comply with the following guidelines.[/p][p]These guidelines are intended [b]for individual players[/b]. If a [b]corporation or organization[/b] wishes to publish or stream gameplay videos, please contact us in advance through our [url="https://pla-neta.co.jp/contact/"]official inquiry form[/url]. Our representative will follow up with you directly.[/p][p][/p][h2]1. Applicable Works[/h2][list][*][p]These guidelines apply to the game software [i]Fruitimo![/i] owned by the Company.[/p][/*][*][p]This includes the officially released product version and any update content.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]2. Streaming and Video Posting[/h2][list][*][p]Individuals are permitted to livestream and upload gameplay videos on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, bilibili, NicoNico, and other social media services.[/p][/*][*][p]You may use the images designated by our company when creating your posts.[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1a1pqfXFroTuJhA-k9lsVLGeko4KOkmWh%3Fusp%3Dsharing"]Materials Available for Posts[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Monetization is permitted only through official partner programs provided by the platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]The following uses are prohibited:[/p][list][*][p]Selling gameplay videos as paid content[/p][/*][*][p]Restricting access behind subscription services or any form of direct paid access[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]3. Content Restrictions[/h2][list][*][p][i]Fruitimo![/i] is designed to be enjoyed safely by children and families. Please refrain from combining the game with the following content:[/p][list][*][p]Expressions that violate public order and morality, or excessive violence/sexual content[/p][/*][*][p]Content that discriminates against or attacks specific races, religions, or ideologies[/p][/*][*][p]Extreme language or depictions likely to cause discomfort to children or general audiences[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Modifying or reusing game data (e.g., extracting character models or music assets) is prohibited.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]4. Spoilers[/h2][list][*][p]As [i]Fruitimo![/i] is a casual game, there are no strict restrictions on spoilers.[/p][/*][*][p]However, please be considerate of first-time players and avoid including story endings directly in video titles or thumbnails.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]5. Copyright Notice[/h2][p]When publishing or distributing content, please include the following copyright notice:[/p][p]© PLANETA Co., Ltd.[/p][p]Additionally, we kindly ask you to include the title and URL wherever possible:[/p][list][*][p]Title: Fruitimo! [/p][/*][*][p]URL: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345000/_/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345000/_/[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For social media posts, we encourage the use of the following hashtags: [b]#フルーティモ #Fruitimo[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]6. Additional Notes[/h2][list][*][p]The Company assumes no responsibility for any trouble, damages, or complaints arising in connection with your streaming or video posting.[/p][/*][*][p]Unless specifically authorized, please do not imply or suggest sponsorship, endorsement, or partnership with the Company or its affiliates.[/p][/*][*][p]If the Company requests removal of content deemed inappropriate, please comply promptly.[/p][/*][*][p]These guidelines are subject to change or update without prior notice.[/p][/*][/list][p]Effective Date: September 18, 2025[/p]

notes.title: How to Play Fruitimo!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Let’s introduce how to play Fruitimo! 🎉[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]＜The 3 Basic Rules＞[/h3][p]1️⃣ [b]Throw jelly![/b]
2️⃣ [b]Vacuum up the fruits you find![/b]
3️⃣ [b]Carry the fruits to the goal![/b][/p][p]When you reach the goal, the results will be shown.
Play again and again to beat your own record![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/2420d0212e21708348cff8eb4583386d736d6631.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]How will you play today?[/b][/h2][p][b]Fruitimo![/b] is a game where you collect fruits and reach the goal…
but that’s not the only way to have fun!
You can play in all sorts of styles depending on your mood.[/p][p]For example…[/p][p][/p][h3]🍓 [b]Collect only your favorite fruit[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/87b643b42f036842ca3918fa308e923b184d52f7.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]🍎 [b]Collect every single fruit[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/4bec7bb071ac035d7fd8815ced3c319aaf8a9d6e.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]🎈 [b]Skip collecting and just explore Kajune Land in your own style[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/f9580077634f49c73d6659d02625fc7185e93497.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]How will you play today?[/p][p]If you find a fun way to play, let us know![/p][p][/p][p]✨ Don’t forget to add [b]Fruitimo![/b] to your wishlist!
👉[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345000/_/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345000/_/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We also post fun updates every day on SNS, so be sure to check them out![/p][p][url="https://x.com/fruitimo"]Fruitimo! Official X[/url][/p][p][url="https://pla-neta.co.jp/fruitimo/"]Fruitimo! Official HP[/url][/p][p]
